error-teamname-taken: Tute mjeno teama so hižo wužiwa
export-card-excel-fields: Wubjerće pola, kotrež maja so do eksporta Excel zapřijeć:
export-card-field-dates: Datumy (wutworjeny, dóstaty, spočatk, termin dospěća, kónc)
export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Eksport do Excela njeje móžny: na tačeli njeje dosć swobodneho městna
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Wužiwar njemóže kartu do PDF eksportować
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Wužiwar njemóže kartu do Excela eksportować
filter-date-range-missing: Tež karty bjez tutoho datuma zapřijeć
filter-date-range-invalid: Wubjerće płaćiwe datumy; kónčny datum dyrbi na spočatnym datumje abo po nim być.
filter-column-age-hint: Schowajće karty, kotrež su so před wjace hač podatej ličbu dnjow do tuteje lisćiny přidali. Druhe lisćiny a karty z njeznatym datumom přidawanja wostanu widźomne. Wobdźěłowanje karty čas w lisćinje znowa njezapočina.
filter-on-desc: Filtrujeće karty na tutej tafli. Klikńće tu, zo byšće filtr wobdźěłał.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Filtrujće datumy kartow z @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt abo @listEnteredAt. Přikład: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' abo @endAt = none. Stajće mjeno swójskeho pola, kotrež so z @ započina, do pazorkow.
advanced-filter-description: Rozšěrjeny filtr dowoluje pisać znamješkowy rjećazk ze slědowacymi operatorami: == != <= >= && || ( ) Mjezera so jako dźělak mjez operatorami wužiwa. Móžeće za wšěmi swójskimi polemi filtrować, hdyž jich mjena a hódnoty zapodaće. Na přikład: Polo1 == Hódnota1. Kedźbu: Jeli pola abo hódnoty mjezery wobsahuja, dyrbiće je do jednorych pazorkow stajić. Na přikład: 'Polo 1' == 'Hódnota 1'. Zo byšće jednotliwe wodźenske znamješka (' \/) přeskočił, móžeće \ wužiwać. Na přikład: Polo1 == I\'m. Móžeće tež wjacore wuměnjenja kombinować. Na přikład: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normalnje so wšě operatory wotlěwa naprawo interpretuja. Porjad móžeće z rjadowanjom spinkow změnić. Na přikład: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Tekstowe pola móžeće tež z regularnymi wurazami přepytować: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Wotpowěduje, hdyž so karta wutwori abo so jeje titul abo wopisanje změni a nowy tekst to wobsahuje (bjez rozeznawanja wulkopisanja).
imported-member-no-account: Importowany čłon — hišće žane wotpowědne konto
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Zasadźće JSON eksporta z Kanboard: objekt z "columns" (abo nadawkami z column_name) a polom "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Stołpiki so lisćiny a nadawki so karty stanu.
import-board-instruction-deck: Zasadźće JSON tafle NextCloud Deck (tafla ze "stacks", hdźež kóždy stack swoje "cards" wobsahuje). Stacki so lisćiny a karty so karty stanu.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Zasadźće JSON zběrki work-packages z OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statusy so lisćiny a dźěłowe pakćiki so karty stanu.
import-board-instruction-issues: Zasadźće JSON-polo issues z __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Issues so karty, zeskupjene do lisćin Wočinjene / Začinjene.
import-board-instruction-asana: Zasadźće JSON eksporta nadawkow z Asana ({ "data": [...] } z eksporta Asana abo GET /tasks). Nadawki so do wotrězkow (memberships) zeskupja; dokónčene nadawki přińdu do Dokónčene.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Zasadźće JSON eksporta lisćiny ze ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Fazy so lisćiny a zapiski so karty stanu.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Zasadźće markdown lisćinu nadawkow (konwencija, kotruž markdown-kanban nastroje kaž Obsidian Kanban wužiwaja): nadpisma "## Mjeno lisćiny" ze zapiskami "- [ ]"/"- [x]" pod nimi. Nadpisma so lisćiny a zapiski so karty stanu; jednora lisćina z dypkami bjez kontrolnych kašćikow so tež importuje, jako wočinjene karty.
import-board-instruction-leo: Zasadźće rozrjad Leo (dataja .leo). Suki najwyšeje runiny so lisćiny stanu, jich podsuki so karty stanu, při čimž so wobsah suka jako wopisanje wužiwa, a hłubše suki so kontrolne lisćiny stanu. Woznamjenjene suki so jako dokónčene importuja.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Zasadźće dataju todo.txt: jedyn nadawk na linku, kaž ju nałoženje todo.txt a kompatibelne nałoženja pisaja. Dokónčene nadawki ("x") přińdu do Dokónčene, +project a @context so etikety stanu, (A) so etiketa priority stanje, a due: a t: so termin dospěća a spočatny datum stanjetej.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Zasadź wuslědk přikaza task export: JSON-polo abo jedyn nadawk na kóždej lince. Dokónčene nadawki přeńdu do Done, project a priority so do popiskow, annotations do komentarow a depends do wotwisnosćow wot blokowacych nadawkow přetworja.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Rozpakujće dataju .boardarchive a zasadźće board.jsonl tafle, z wersijowej linku abo bjez njeje. Kajkosć zeskupjenja napohlada tafle so lisćiny stanu, druhe wuběrne kajkosće so etikety stanu, bloki teksta a kontrolnych kašćikow so wopisanje a kontrolna lisćina stanu a komentary so zachowaja. Wobrazy a přiwěški so njeimportuja.
import-board-instruction-todoist: W Todoist wočińće projekt, wubjerće meni ⋯ horjeka naprawo, potom Manage data > Export as CSV, a zasadźće dataju CSV. Wotrězki so lisćiny stanu, nadawki so karty stanu, podnadawki so kontrolna lisćina stanu, noticy so komentary stanu, a @labels a priority p1 hač p3 so etikety stanu.
import-board-instruction-planner: W Microsoft Planner wočińće plan, wubjerće meni ⋯ pódla jeho mjena, potom Export as Excel (w klasiskim Planner: Export plan to Excel), a wubjerće tutu dataju .xlsx. Buckets so lisćiny a nadawki so karty stanu, z jich zamołwitymi, datumami, etiketami, kontrolnej lisćinu a wopisanjom; Progress, Priority a Completed By so swójske pola stanu.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-planka: Zapisajće adresu swojeho Planka (na přikład https://planka.example.com), swoje wužiwarske mjeno a hesło za Planka, potom stłóčće Nalistować. Wužiwaja so jenož za wobstaranje tafle a njeskładuja so. Wubjerće taflu a stłóčće Wobstarać: WeKan ju z API Planka čita, z jeje lisćinami, kartami, wopisanjemi, terminami dospěća, etiketami, čłonami, nadawkowymi lisćinami a komentarami, potom pokročujće z importom kaž přeco. Karty w archiwje Planka so archiwowane importuja; přiwěški a karty w papjernikowym kóšu so njeimportuja.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: W Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) přizjewće so, přizwolće prawo Tasks.Read a kopěrujće token z rajtarka Access token. Zasadźće jón tu a klikńće na Nalistować; token so jenož za tute wobstaranje wužiwa a njeskładuje so. Wubjerće wšě lisćiny abo jednu lisćinu a klikńće na Wobstarać. Kóžda lisćina To Do budźe lisćina a kóždy nadawk karta, z jeho noticami, terminom dospěća a spočatnym datumom, krokami jako kontrolna lisćina, kategorijemi jako etiketami, a wysokej wažnosću a statusom jako etiketami; dokónčene nadawki so archiwuja. Dopomnjenki a wospjetowanja so njeimportuja.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: W KanbanFlow wočińće meni tafle, wubjerće Settings → API & Webhooks a kopěrujće API-token tafle. Zasadźće token tu, klikńće na Nalistować, wubjerće taflu a klikńće na Wobstarać; token so jenož za tute wobstaranje wužiwa a njeskładuje so. Stołpiki budu lisćiny a dróhi wostanu dróhi; nadawki wobchowaja swoje wopisanje, barbu, etikety, termin dospěća, podnadawki jako kontrolnu lisćinu, wudaty čas, pohódnoćenje, ludźi a komentary.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Zapisajće ID swojeho konta Basecamp (ličbu za basecamp.com/ w adresy) a přistupny token (z OAuth 2 nałoženja zregistrowaneho na launchpad.37signals.com abo tón, kotryž eksistowaca integracija hižo ma), klikńće na Nalistować, wubjerće projekt a klikńće na Wobstarać. Token so jenož za tute wobstaranje wužiwa a njeskładuje so. Kóžda kartowa tabela budźe dróha ze swojimi stołpikami jako lisćinami, a lisćiny nadawkow budu dróha Nadawki; karty a nadawki wobchowaja swój tekst, datumy, zamołwitych a komentary, kroki karty budu kontrolna lisćina a dokónčene nadawki so archiwuja.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Wobstarajće sej přistupny token z OAuth 2.0 Playground: pod Tasks API v1 wubjerće tasks.readonly, klikńće na Authorize APIs, potom na Exchange authorization code for tokens, a kopěrujće přistupny token. Zasadźće jón tu a klikńće na Nalistować, wubjerće wšě nadawkowe lisćiny abo jednu, potom Wobstarać. Token so jenož za tute wobstaranje wužiwa a njeskładuje so. Nadawkowe lisćiny budu lisćiny a nadawki budu karty, z jich noticami, wotkazami a terminom dospěća; podnadawki budu kontrolna lisćina a dokónčene nadawki so archiwowane importuja.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API Google Keep je jenož za konta Google Workspace. Wobstarajće sej přistupny token OAuth 2.0 z wobłukom https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (w OAuth 2.0 Playground, jeli administrator wašeho Workspace to dowoli, abo ze słužbneho konta z delegaciju za cyłu domenu), zasadźće jón, klikńće na Nalistować a potom na Wobstarać. Token so jenož za tute wobstaranje wužiwa a njeskładuje so. Tekstowe notice budu karty w lisćinje Notice, a notice kontrolnych lisćin budu karty w lisćinje Lisćiny z jich zapiskami jako kontrolnej lisćinu. Notice w papjernikowym kóšu, přiwěški a dźělenje so njeimportuja.
api-import-desc: Wobstarajće jón ze słužby ze swojim kontom. Štož tu zapisujeće, so jenož za tute wobstaranje wužiwa a njeskładuje so.
api-import-fetched: Wobstarane. Přepruwujće čłonow deleka a importujće.
api-import-nothing: Z tutym kontom ničo k importowanju njeje.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.
import-board-instruction-trello: Na wašej tafli Trello dźiće do 'Menu', potom 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', a kopěrujće wuslědny tekst.
import-board-instruction-csv: Zasadźće swoje Comma Separated Values (CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Zasadźće JSON pytanja issues z Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (bjez fields so jenož ID issues wróćeja). Wulki projekt přińdźe po stronach, kóžda z nextPageToken za přichodnu: stajće issues wšěch stronow do jednoho pola "issues", abo importujće kóždu stronu jako swójsku taflu z Wjele taflow importować. Ekwiwalentny objekt { "issues": [...] } tež funguje. Statusy Jira so lisćiny a issues so karty stanu. Opcionalnje přidajće polo "automationRules", zo byšće prawidła importował.
import-board-instruction-excel: Wubjerće zešiwk .xlsx: tabela z jednej kartu na rynk (stołpiki kaž Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, datumy a swójske pola), abo zešiwk, kotryž je WeKan eksportował, tež tajki, w kotrymž je kóžda tafla na swójskim łopjenje. Přichodny krok pokaza, kotry stołpik je kotre polo. Kóžde łopjeno z hłowowym rynkom so tafla stanje.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Na wašej tafli dźiće do 'Menu', potom 'Export board', a kopěrujće tekst ze sćehnjeneje dataje.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Hdyž při importowanju tafle zmylki dóstanjeće, import druhdy přeco hišće funguje a tafla je na stronje Wšě tafle.
import-members-mode-map: Choose an existing user for each of them
import-members-mode-placeholder: Keep them as placeholder users with their own names, to map to real users later
csv-mapping-description: Choose the column of the file that holds each card field. The choices were made from the column names; change any that are wrong, and choose (not in the file) for a field the file does not have.
csv-mapping-list-missing: The file has no column for the list. Choose one above, or type the name of the one list every card goes into.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Other columns to import as text custom fields:
csv-mapping-boards: Each sheet becomes its own board:
csv-mapping-title-required: Choose the column that holds the card titles.
csv-mapping-list-required: Type the name of the list every card goes into, or choose the column that holds the list.
invalid-import-mapping: The column mapping does not match the file.
import-many-boards-hint: Choose several export files of this tool, or one .zip that holds them: each file becomes its own board, imported without member mapping. A .zip that is itself one export (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, or WeKan with attachments) is one board. When files are chosen here, Import imports them instead of the field above.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Each swimlane the import would make (a project, folder or list of the tool) becomes its own board. Parent cards and dependencies between those boards are listed in the import report.
export-all-boards-hint: Every board you can export, in one download: Excel as one workbook with a sheet per board named after it, every other format as a .zip with a file per board.
import-attachments-zip: ZIP z přiwěškami Trello (opcionalny, z Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Jedna tafla Trello eksportowana jako .json. Jeli sće kluč API a token Trello składował, so tež jeje přiwěški, pozadk tafle a awatary čłonow sćehnu.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Dataja .zip z jednej abo wjacorymi datajemi .json taflow a jich přiwěškami w podrjadowakach z mjenom tafle (z Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Wšě tafle so importuja.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: W dataji .zip njejsu so žane dataje .json taflow Trello namakali.
import-trello-zip-progress: Tafle so z dataje .zip importuja, prošu čakajće…
import-trello-failed: Importowanje z Trello je so njeporadźiło.
import-timeout: Import je předołho trał a bu zastajeny. Prošu spytajće hišće raz; jeli so to wospjetuje, je tafla snano přewulka abo datowa banka přećežena.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: Dataja .zip wobsahuje přewjele datajow za import.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Dataja w .zip je přewulka za import.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: Dataja .zip wobsahuje njewěste šćežki k datajam a bu wotpokazana.
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Importowana tafla so do tutoho dźěłoweho wobłuka staji; wutwori so, jeli njeeksistuje
trello-api-import: Direktnje z Trello z klučom API a tokenom importować
trello-api-import-desc: Zasadźće swój kluč API a token Trello, zo byšće swoje dźěłowe wobłuki a tafle Trello nalistował, a importujće potom wubrane z jich přiwěškami.
trello-api-token: Token API Trello (ručnje wutworjeny pod klučom API)
trello-api-credentials-required: Prošu zapodajće kluč API a token Trello.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Kluč API a token Trello stej składowanej. Móžeće dźěłowe wobłuki nalistować, bjez toho zo byšće je znowa zapodał.
trello-export-desc: Create a copy of this board in Trello through Trello's API, with your Trello API key and token. Swimlanes become labels named "Swimlane: …", which WeKan's Trello import turns back into swimlanes.
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: A Sandstorm grain has no Internet access of its own. Allow this grain to reach Trello first.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, for importing and exporting boards
trello-select-boards: Prošu wubjerće znajmjeńša jednu taflu za import.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: Import přetorhnyć a tafle, kotrež su so z tutym nadawkom hižo importowali, zhašeć? To njeda so cofnyć.

r-wrike-workflow-note: A Wrike workflow is a list of statuses, each in the Active, Completed, Deferred or Cancelled group. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

dueCardsViewChange-choice-all-descriptio: Pokazuje wšě njedokónčene karty z *terminom dospěća* z taflow, za kotrež ma wužiwar prawo.
globalSearchViewChange-choice-all-descri: Wšě karty na taflach pytać, za kotrež maće prawo. Wubjerće *Moje karty*, zo byšće wuslědki na karty wobmjezowali, hdźež sće čłon abo přidźěleny.

operator-limit-invalid: %s njeje płaćiwe wobmjezowanje. Wobmjezowanje dyrbi pozitiwna cyła ličba być.
globalSearch-instructions-description: Pytanja móža operatory wobsahować, zo bychu pytanje wudokładnili. Operatory so podawaja, hdyž so mjeno operatora a hódnota, dźělenej z dwudypkom, napisatej. Na přikład podaće operatora `list:Blocked` by pytanje na karty wobmjezowało, kotrež su w lisćinje z mjenom *Blocked*. Jeli hódnota mjezery abo wosebite znamješka wobsahuje, dyrbi do pazorkow zasadźena być (na př. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - karty w taflach, kotrež podatemu *<title>* wotpowěduja
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - karty w lisćinach, kotrež podatemu *<title>* wotpowěduja
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - karty w dróhach, kotrež podatemu *<title>* wotpowěduja
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - karty, kotrež słušeja k tafli, přidźělenej organizaciji *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - karty, kotrež słušeja k tafli, přidźělenej teamej *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - karty, kotrychž termin dospěća je hač do *<n>* dnjow wot nětka. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ nalistuje wšě karty po jich terminje dospěća.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - karty, které byly vytvořeny před *<n>* abo méně dny
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - karty, kotrež buchu před *<n>* abo mjenje dnjemi změnjene
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - kde *<field>* je jedno z `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` nebo `__predicate_member__`.  Zadáním `-` před *<field>* vyhledáte karty, které dané políčko němají zadané (např. `haz:-due` vyhledá karty bjez zadaného termínu).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - kde *<sort-name>* je jedno z `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` nebo `__predicate_modified__`.  Pro zeztupné řazení zadejte před mjeno `-`.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - kde *<n>* je kladné celé čízlo vyjadřující počet karet zobrazených na jedné ztránce.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Podobne operatory so z *OR* zwjazuja. Wróćeja so karty, kotrež někajkemu z wuměnjenjow wotpowěduja.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` by karty wróćiło, kotrež su w někajkej lisćinje z mjenom *Blocked* abo *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Rozdźělne operatory so z *AND* zwjazuja. Wróćeja so jenož karty, kotrež wšěm rozdźělnym operatoram wotpowěduja. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` wróći jenož karty w lisćinje *Available* z *čerwjenej* etiketu.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Dny hodźa so jako pozitiwna abo negatiwna cyła ličba podać abo z `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` abo `__predicate_year__` za aktualny čas.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Tekstowe pytanja wulke a małe pismiki njerozeznawaja.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Po standardźe so archiwowane karty njepytaja.
